name: KISS x 500 KISSken, Hatsudou
source:
The main character lives on an island. There is a unique unwritten law that a person who kisses is arrested and imprisoned for five years. Kissing is strictly prohibited on the island. He always thinks of living a life full of kisses. 

One day, his pent-up desire to kiss explodes and tries to kiss girls around him, but he fails... "We have the right to kiss!!!" He decides to leave the island... Why is kissing banned on the island...? 

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
主人公生活在一座岛上。岛上有一条独特的不成文法：接吻的人会被逮捕，并监禁五年。接吻在岛上受到严格禁止。他却总是向往充满亲吻的生活。

某天，长久压抑的接吻欲望终于爆发，他试图亲吻身边的女孩，却接连失败……“我们有接吻的权利！！！”他决定离开这座岛……岛上为何禁止接吻……？

[摘自Himeya Shop]
